initial_application_state: Reviewer-controlled frozen CRUD/authorization fixture and implementer-generated negative suite; snapshots of users/notes/report/protected state.
required_inputs: Six categories: unauthenticated, unauthorized, foreign ownership, invalid, malicious and sensitive-field manipulation; forbidden method.
expected_outputs: Defined401/403/404/422/405 with safe body and exact unchanged denied state; all six tests execute.
forbidden_outputs: Secrets, traces, protected or foreign fields; schema deviations.
expected_side_effects: Allowed controls succeed; denied requests do not mutate protected state.
forbidden_side_effects: Skipped-as-passing, status-only proof, mocked-away access enforcement, assertions weakened for mutants.
required_security_behavior: Actual configured authentication and server-side authorization, safe output, unchanged denied state.
Security Reviewer clearance required; no implementation author may provide it.

required_tests.requirement: All six negative categories execute and pass clean; persisted state and safe output asserted.
Evaluator-supplied isolated defects cause relevant assertion failures; clean rerun passes.
Revision, commands/results and no secrets/fabricated evidence.

independent_verification_checks: Reviewer freezes executable assertions, adapter and fixture bytes before implementation.
Reviewer independently reruns clean candidate and relevant mutations; reads DB/response evidence, not implementer claims.
Hash candidate before/after variants; rerun clean candidate; verify criterion coverage and regression results.

inherited: Use BE-001/002/005 applicable missing/null/empty/whitespace/zero/negative/type/unknown matrices; do not count irrelevant body fields on read routes.

fault_variants.mutation: Reviewer removes owner check in disposable CRUD copy
fault_variants.isolation: New disposable copy per fault; no clean-source overwrite; hash mutation and unchanged tests.
fault_variants.detection: Relevant assertion failure with zero infrastructure errors; clean baseline and rerun PASS.

binding_requirements: Reviewer assigns concrete project routes/schema/DB/auth/error mappings without weakening original criteria.
Reviewer implements every required_tests ID and input_regressions vector in executable stack-specific assertions; independent catalog approval before candidate work.
